program: P1.6 Reality Repair Sprint — Phase 6: Precursor Replay Revalidation

p1_limitations: 8-hour telemetry gap before Incident 1 (zero visibility in T-60m window)
Only 21 records in Incident 2 T-60m window
Only 20 total health telemetry snapshots across 64 hours
Sample size of 2 incidents (1 true, 1 scoring artifact)

signals_found.description: Interpolated action records confirm system was active during the 8-hour gap (not idle/offline). 93 minute-cadence interpolated records fill the gap.
signals_found.limitation: Interpolated records carry action metadata only — no system metrics (memory, CPU, load). Cannot observe resource trends.

signals_NOT_found: No memory pressure trends (interpolated records lack health telemetry)
No CPU usage trajectory (no metric data in gap)
No load average progression (no metric data in gap)
No process count drift data (no metric data in gap)
t_minus_60m.assessment: Minimal improvement. Interpolated action records confirm system activity but cannot reveal precursor resource metrics. The 8-hour gap remains a blind spot for health telemetry.

signals_found.description: Interpolated records in T-30m have average confidence 0.74, indicating proximity to known data anchor points

t_minus_30m.assessment: Moderate confidence that system was actively processing during this window. Still no health metric data.

signals_found.description: Interpolated records reach 0.93 average confidence — close to the incident anchor. Activity pattern is highly reliable.

t_minus_10m.assessment: High confidence in activity pattern. Still no health/metric precursor data. Real records are all at 21:48-21:49 (the incident moment itself).

signals_found.description: 22 REAL records concentrated at 21:48:54-21:49:02 — the incident trigger burst. Includes health score (65.79), reflex data (mem=99.28%, cpu=17.56%, load_1m=2.8), and action logs.

t_minus_5m.assessment: Strong real data AT the incident but only within seconds of the trigger. No advance warning signals visible even with 5-minute window.

precursor_verdict.earliest_actionable_detection: 0 seconds (acute signals only visible at incident moment)
precursor_verdict.improvement_over_p1: Marginal — we now know the system was active during the gap, but cannot detect specific resource trends
precursor_verdict.limitation: Interpolated records from the 8-hour gap are action-type only, not health/metric. The backfill engine had no source health data to interpolate from for this window.

signals_found.description: INC-001 occurred at T-25m (21:49:02) within this window. Full incident data now visible with health scores, reflex telemetry, and recovery trajectory.
Complete health score timeline: 65.79 (at INC-001) → 76.07 → 76.37 → stabilized at 76.5. Clear recovery visible across 41 health records.
Memory trending DOWN from 99.28% (INC-001) to 97.6-97.8% in 17 post-incident snapshots, continuing to 96.21% at INC-002 time. Opposite of true memory pressure precursor.
CPU dropped from 17.56% (INC-001 spike) to 2.37-10% in post-incident burst, stabilizing at 5.44% by INC-002. No escalating CPU trend.
Memory pressure diagnosis generated at 22:04:14 and 22:04:33 (T-10m). System was actively investigating the condition.
Process count stable at 665-668 across 66 metric records. No drift or accumulation pattern.

t_minus_60m.assessment: Dramatically improved. 377 records (286 REAL) provide complete visibility of the cascade from INC-001 → INC-002. Key finding: memory was DECREASING, CPU was NORMALIZING — confirming INC-002 as scoring artifact, not true precursor.

signals_found.description: 286 REAL records in 30-minute window. Near-complete visibility of system state with 41 health records, 66 metric records, 5 reflex records.
INC-001 occurred at T-25m (21:49:02), inside this window. Full incident context preserved.

t_minus_30m.assessment: Near-perfect visibility. Average confidence 0.992. This window is now fully characterized.

signals_found.description: Memory pressure diagnosis at 22:04:14-33 preceded this window. System was processing the known condition.

t_minus_10m.assessment: Good coverage. 20 records including reflex data at 22:14:35 (2 seconds before incident timestamp). The lower density compared to T-30m reflects the quiet period between diagnosis and re-trigger.

signals_found.description: Reflex re-evaluated at 22:14:35 with memory=96.21%, CPU=5.44%. No acute escalation visible — system was stable.

t_minus_5m.assessment: Stable system state. Memory lower than INC-001 by 3 percentage points. No acute precursor signals. Confirms scoring artifact classification.

precursor_verdict.earliest_actionable_detection: 25 minutes (INC-001 as strongest predictor of INC-002 re-trigger)
precursor_verdict.improvement_over_p1: Dramatic — from 21 records to 377 records, with complete health/metric trajectory. False positive (scoring artifact) classification strongly reinforced.
precursor_verdict.limitation: INC-002 is not a true incident. Improved precursor detection for INC-002 reflects better characterization of a false alarm, not genuine precursor capability.

revised_precursor_clusters.name: Multi-Signal Resource Saturation
revised_precursor_clusters.justification: Slightly improved. INC-2 dense data confirms this pattern was ABSENT during the scoring artifact (CPU=5.44%, load=1.75 — both normal). This improves specificity — we now know the pattern is specific to true incidents. But INC-1's gap still prevents validating early detection.
revised_precursor_clusters.false_positive_rate: LOW (0/1 non-incident windows showed this pattern)
revised_precursor_clusters.false_positive_caveat: n=1 is insufficient for reliable FP estimation

revised_precursor_clusters.name: Persistent Memory Saturation (Background State)
revised_precursor_clusters.justification: Unchanged. Backfill confirms memory stayed above 96% throughout. Dense data in INC-2 window shows memory at 96.21-99.28% — still a chronic condition, not an acute precursor. False positive rate remains 92%.

revised_precursor_clusters.name: Process Count Gradual Drift
revised_precursor_clusters.justification: Slight improvement. 66 metric records in INC-2 window show process count stable at 665-668 (no drift in the 60min window). This suggests the 617→667 drift happened gradually over hours, not in the immediate pre-incident window. Backfill adds temporal context but not the actual drift trajectory.
revised_precursor_clusters.false_positive_rate: MODERATE — stable high count persists in non-incident windows too

revised_precursor_clusters.name: Prior Incident Cascade
revised_precursor_clusters.justification: Major improvement. Dense backfill data (377 records) provides complete cascade trajectory: INC-001 trigger → health score drop (65.79) → recovery (76.5) → memory decrease (99.28→96.21%) → reflex re-trigger at INC-002. The cascade is now fully documented. However, this pattern only predicts scoring artifacts, not true incidents.
revised_precursor_clusters.false_positive_rate: HIGH — the cascade predicted a FALSE alarm (INC-002), not a true incident
revised_precursor_clusters.caveat: This cluster detects reflex re-evaluation, not genuine new incidents. Useful for incident deduplication, not precursor detection.

improvements.improvement: Now confirmed as absent during scoring artifact — improved specificity
WORSENED — dense data confirms cascade predicted a false alarm, not a true incident

false_positive_analysis_upgrade.overall_false_positive_assessment: Dense backfill data improved specificity for PC-001 (multi-signal) and worsened apparent reliability of PC-004 (cascade). Net improvement in discrimination ability.

INC-001.p16_earliest_actionable: 0 seconds (unchanged — interpolated data lacks health metrics)
INC-001.p16_earliest_contextual: 60 minutes (interpolated activity records confirm system was active)
INC-001.improvement: Contextual: from 8h to 60m (we now know the gap wasn't downtime). Actionable: unchanged (no health metrics in interpolated data).

INC-002.p16_earliest_actionable: 25 minutes (INC-001 occurrence, fully documented with 317 real records)
INC-002.p16_earliest_contextual: 60 minutes (full cascade with 377 records, avg confidence 0.925)
INC-002.improvement: Dramatic: from 21 records to 377 records. Complete cascade trajectory visible. But INC-002 is a scoring artifact.

new_precursor_detection_accuracy.methodology: Weighted factors with same structure as P1, re-evaluated with backfilled evidence

precursor_patterns_identified.justification: 4 clusters better characterized; PC-004 now fully documented with 377 records; PC-001 specificity confirmed

false_positive_discrimination.justification: Dense INC-2 data confirms scoring artifact classification with clear evidence (memory decreasing, CPU normalizing). PC-001 absent in artifact. Improved from indeterminate to measurable.

earliest_detection_window.justification: INC-2 now has 60-minute dense window with 377 records. INC-1 still limited to 0-second actionable detection (interpolated data lacks metrics). Weighted average improvement.

observability_coverage.justification: 438 backfilled records fill incident windows. INC-2 window: 377 records (was 21). INC-1 window: 115 records (was 0). Forward-looking 5-min sampling engine built. Coverage improved from ~0% to ~28% in incident windows.

statistical_confidence_sample_size.justification: Still n=2 incidents (1 true, 1 artifact). Dense data improves per-incident analysis confidence but doesn't increase sample size. Marginal improvement from better characterization.

scoring_artifact_identification_bonus.justification: Scoring artifact (INC-002) classification now backed by 377 records with clear evidence: memory decreasing (99.28→96.21%), CPU normalizing (17.56→5.44%), no multi-signal pattern present. Upgraded from 'classification' to 'well-evidenced classification'.

new_precursor_detection_accuracy.confidence_notes: Score reflects real improvements in observability and false positive discrimination, but is capped by: (1) INC-1 interpolated data lacking health metrics, (2) INC-2 being a scoring artifact not a true incident, (3) n=2 sample size.

key_improvements: INC-1 window: 0 → 115 records (∞ improvement from zero baseline)
False positive discrimination: INDETERMINATE → measurable for 2 of 4 clusters
Cascade trajectory (PC-004): fully documented with real health data
Forward-looking sampling engine (5-min max cadence) now operational
remaining_limitations: INC-1 health telemetry gap: interpolated records are action-type only, no system metrics
38-hour post-incident gap (GAP-002): unrecoverable, no source data
Sample size: still only 2 incidents (1 true, 1 artifact)
INC-2 improvement validates artifact detection, not true precursor detection
Somatic attention data: still only 1 snapshot in entire history
